capabilities: dim inactive panes when the workspace has multiple splits
move the dimming instantly to the pane receiving focus
toggle dimming from the command palette
adjust the light level of dimmed panes in settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual (copying files into .obsidian/plugins/); no community plugin store link or screenshots are given.
problem: Obsidian leaves all open panes at full brightness, so with multiple splits it is harder to keep your eyes on the active one.
summary: Workspace utility that dims all inactive editor panes to a set opacity, keeping visual focus on the pane you are currently working in.
